verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own way to make agents react to outside events: agent threads can subscribe to external resources and receive webhook or polling events as signals. It also offers production workflows with retries and branches that run on a deployed server. Together these are an event-driven form of background automation, but nothing shows a user setting up recurring or scheduled automations that run unattended. Missing for 10: recurring/cron-style scheduling, documented background or unattended execution of workflows, a user-facing setup flow for automations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
Compose typed steps, retries, and branches into production workflows your team can inspect and ship.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
